digest.component_or_area: nginx edge configuration, mcp http service
propositions: The documented MCP client URL https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/mcp/ (with trailing slash) responds with a 307 redirect to http://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/mcp, downgrading HTTPS to HTTP and exposing bearer PAT tokens to interception.

A prefix location /mcp with URI-preserving proxy_pass combined with the app mounting at http_path=/mcp causes Starlette's redirect_slashes to emit the 307, while the documented nginx pattern uses exact-match locations to avoid this.

The mcp container service does not set FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS, causing uvicorn to default to 127.0.0.1 and distrust nginx's X-Forwarded-Proto header, resulting in http:// scheme derivation despite nginx sending https.
The 443 server block lacks an HSTS header, providing no backstop to prevent clients from following the 307 downgrade or to pin the https scheme for future requests.

The fix requires four coordinated changes: exact-match location blocks for /mcp/ and /mcp, proxy_redirect to upgrade Location headers, HSTS header on the 443 server, and FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS=* on the mcp compose service.
